### Added
- **muster and Substrate export OTLP traces (muster also logs) to `otlp-gateway.kube-system.svc:4317`** (giantswarm/giantswarm#36711). `muster.muster.observability.otel.endpoint` carries the collector and `.headers` sets `X-Scope-OrgID: giantswarm`, the same tenant header kagent, agentgateway and klaus-gateway send; `substrate.otel.endpoint` does the same for ate-api-server, ate-controller, atenet-router and atelet, whose `otel.traces` / `otel.metrics` / `otel.logs` blocks were already `enabled: true` with no endpoint to reach. The Substrate chart carries no OTLP-headers key for any of its four components, so its signals reach the collector without the tenant header until it grows one.
